智能体交差前统一把关：错别字、格式乱、瞎编事实先筛一遍。

Also trigger on phrases like 我不敢公开演讲, 团队执行力差, 为什么学不会, 如何改变一个习惯, 教练式提问, 诊断绩效问题, 文化变革, or any request to map a problem onto the six levels. Do NOT trigger for pure NLP (natural language processing) technical tasks unless the user explicitly references Dilts or Bateson logical levels.
